Balaji Amines Limited stands as a pioneering force in India's chemical manufacturing sector, headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra. Established in 1988, this dynamic company has evolved into one of India's leading manufacturers of aliphatic amines and their derivatives, playing a crucial role in the nation's chemical industry landscape.

The company specializes in producing a comprehensive range of methylamines, ethylamines, and their derivatives, along with various specialty chemicals that serve diverse industrial applications. With a strong commitment to quality and innovation, Balaji Amines has built an impressive portfolio that caters to pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, rubber chemicals, water treatment chemicals, and numerous other sectors both domestically and internationally.

Operating multiple state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities across India, Balaji Amines Limited has established itself as a reliable supplier with a robust distribution network spanning over 35 countries. The company's dedication to sustainable practices, technological advancement, and customer satisfaction has earned it various certifications and accolades in the chemical industry. Their strategic location in Solapur, Maharashtra, provides excellent connectivity to major industrial hubs, enabling efficient supply chain management and timely delivery of products. Today, Balaji Amines continues to strengthen its position as a key contributor to India's growing chemical sector while maintaining its focus on environmental responsibility and operational excellence.
